proposal.falsification: With the frozen task, labels, seed set and resource ceilings, reject the developmental improvement hypothesis if primary development loss does not improve over the supplied parent when available, or the candidate lacks supported finite primary output. Only the predeclared independent system and representation comparisons can establish their respective claims; developmental improvement alone is insufficient.
proposal.hypothesis: For the fixed 12-hour volatility task, replace the interaction MLP with summary statistics while retaining temporal filtering and eight output dimensions. Window dispersion, level, extrema and endpoint changes may provide a more useful bounded representation than learning the full ordered flattened window under the same training and seed budgets. This is an untested inductive-bias hypothesis, not evidence of new information.

proposal.falsification: The developmental improvement hypothesis is falsified if the gated candidate has primary development loss greater than or equal to 0.17901924187392135 on the same eligible samples, fails finite supported outputs, or exceeds the frozen budget. Auxiliary first-event and state metrics are diagnostics and cannot replace the volatility success criterion. Independent system and frozen-representation conclusions remain separate and use their unchanged predeclared comparisons.
proposal.hypothesis: The current temporal-plus-summary parent has development volatility loss 0.17901924187392135 with finite coverage. A gated combination may adapt the relative use of temporal and summary representations to the observed state and reduce volatility loss within the same declared training and seed ceilings. This tests the complete gated configuration, including its changed downstream dimension and parameter count, rather than attributing a difference solely to gating.

proposal.falsification: Reject the primary improvement hypothesis if summary-only primary development loss is greater than or equal to 0.17901924187392135 on identical eligible coverage, or supported finite primary output is lost. Report actual parameter and elapsed-cost changes independently; lower resource use alone cannot establish the predeclared predictive increment. Do not promote the candidate using auxiliary event/state metrics or revise confirmation thresholds.
proposal.hypothesis: Gating failed to improve the primary volatility development loss: 0.1800618258986162 versus the concat parent at 0.17901924187392135, despite better auxiliary metrics. Test whether the learned temporal module is unnecessary for this fixed volatility task by removing it and fully retraining the summary-only configuration. Reducing representational and downstream capacity may improve primary loss under the same declared seeds and ceilings; this is a retrained configuration comparison, not a causal attribution or proof that temporal information is absent.

proposal.falsification: Reject the improvement hypothesis if the four-dimensional summary candidate has primary development loss greater than or equal to 0.17711663536872357 on identical eligible coverage, loses finite primary supervision, or exceeds a frozen ceiling. Record whether the actual parameter/cost reduction occurs, but do not call compression a new independent factor or substitute auxiliary first-event/state improvement for the primary task. Independent confirmation and matched-dimension representation comparisons retain their original criteria.
proposal.hypothesis: Removing temporal reduced primary development volatility loss from 0.17901924187392135 to 0.17711663536872357 and parameters from 3788 to 2716 on the same reported coverage. Test whether the remaining summary representation can be compressed from eight to four dimensions: a narrower learned representation and downstream head may retain the task-relevant window summaries and improve volatility loss under the same fixed seeds and training ceilings.
